facts.text: The user asked to revise the chronology based on the rule that if Brother Day dies, a clone of Brother Day can replace him even within the same generation.
The user described a genetic dynasty succession where Brother Day is succeeded by Brother Dawn at a certain old age.
The user said that Brother Dawn is then renamed to Brother Day.
The user said the former Brother Day becomes Brother Dusk.
The user said the former Brother Dusk becomes Brother Darkness.
The user said that Brother Darkness is vapourised.
The user said that the ashes of Brother Darkness are used to bless the new infant Cleon I clone.
The user said that the new infant Cleon I clone becomes Brother Dawn.

keyphrases: Brother Dawn renamed to Brother Day

events.text: Brother Day dies and is replaced by a clone of Brother Day within the same generation (chronology revision requested).

Brother Day reaches a certain old age and is succeeded by Brother Dawn, who is renamed to Brother Day; the former Brother Day becomes Brother Dusk, then Brother Darkness, which is vapourised; ashes bless the new infant Cleon I clone, which becomes Brother Dawn.
